title: Add a `remove` command
probe: Happy path: easy ticket, no blockers. Should be picked first and end in a green PR.
body:
## What

Add `Store.remove(task_id)` and a `remove <id>` CLI command. Removing a missing id raises `KeyError`, like `done`.

## Acceptance criteria

- `python3 -m todo.cli remove 1` deletes task 1 and prints `removed 1: <title>`
- Unit tests cover removing an existing and a missing id

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately)

title: Add due dates to tasks
probe: Blocker handling: must stay blocked until ticket 1 is done (merged or closed).
body:
## What

`add` takes an optional `--due YYYY-MM-DD`. Stored as `"due"` on the task (absent when not given). `list` shows the date after the title.

## Acceptance criteria

- Invalid dates are rejected with a clear error, nothing is saved
- Old task files without `due` still load
- Unit tests for valid, invalid and missing dates

## Blocked by

- {#1}

title: List overdue tasks first
probe: Blocker chain: blocked by ticket 2, which is itself blocked by ticket 1.
body:
## What

`list` puts open tasks whose due date is before today first, marked with `!`. Then the rest in id order.

## Acceptance criteria

- Today's date can be injected in tests (no real clock in assertions)
- Done tasks are never marked overdue

## Blocked by

- {#2}

title: Reject duplicate task titles
probe: Gate failure: the obvious change breaks the existing test `test_add_twice_keeps_both`. Exercises fix rounds and, if the agent gives up, the draft PR with 'Needs a human'.
body:
## What

`Store.add` raises `ValueError` when an open task with the same title (case-insensitive) already exists. Done tasks don't count.

## Acceptance criteria

- CLI prints an error and exits 1 on a duplicate
- Existing tests updated to match the new rule

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately)
